header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: ﷺ and upon his wives, the mothers of the believers (Mu'mins), and upon his descendants and all the people of his household, shower mercy! Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.'” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ رُوَيْفِعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ صَلَّي عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَقَالَ: اَللّهُمَّ أَنْزِلْهُ الْمَقْعَدَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَجَبَتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار والطبراني في الاوسط والكبير واسانيدهم حسنة مجمع الزوائد:١٠ /٢٥٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ruwaifi' ibn Thabit (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “If anyone recites upon Muhammad ﷺ the Salawat (اَللّهُمَّ أَنْزِلْهُ الْمَقْعَدَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَة) “O Allah, seat Muhammad ﷺ on the Day of Qiyamah in a special place close to You!', my intercession for him becomes binding upon me.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَقُولُ: يَاعَبْدِي مَا عَبَدْتَنِي وَرَجَوْتَنِي فَإِنِّي غَافِرٌ لَّكَ عَلي مَا كَانَ فِيكَ وَيَاعَبْدِي إِنْ لَقِيتَنِي بِقُرَابِ اْلاَرْضِ خَطِيئَةً مَالَمْ تُشْرِكْ بِي لَقِيتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً.
blocks.tamil_translation: “O My servant! As long as you keep worshipping Me and keep your hope in Me (for forgiveness), I will keep forgiving you, no matter how many sins you have. O My servant, even if you meet Me with sins filling the earth, as long as you have not associated anyone as a partner with Me, I too will meet you with forgiveness filling the earth” (I will forgive completely)
